declaration.statement: Candidate narrow target-schema evidence: at the declared Cilium v1.19.7 source commit, every represented fromRequires/toRequires array in both CiliumNetworkPolicy and CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy CRD schemas has maxItems: 0. This packet does not claim historical support removal or API-server admission, pruning, startup, traffic, or whole-upgrade behavior. The executable rule uses only the existing operator-declared component.cilium.nonempty_requires_fields fact; false is valid only for definite absence across the complete relevant set.

limitations: The exact 1.18.13 to 1.19.7 tag bindings and retained source bytes require independent verification.
The evidence is limited to target CRD schema declarations for CNP and CCNP and says nothing about historical support removal.
The check uses manually declared facts and does not inspect files, clusters, API-server admission, or stored objects.
A true nonempty-array declaration yields only a scoped BLOCKED result; it is not a runtime or startup prediction.
False requires a definite complete-set absence declaration; missing, partial, empty, unsupported, or ambiguous input cannot be treated as false.
The result does not cover traffic policy behavior, conversion, pruning, deployment order, or whole-upgrade safety.
